# CommunityDownload

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish.Community` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class CommunityDownload
```

Fetches a listed Set into a cache folder and proves it is what the gallery lists before anything opens it. The download is unauthenticated: the link is a public release download that may redirect to a CDN, so no token is ever attached.

## Methods

### FetchAsync(HttpClient, CommunityEntry, string, IProgress&lt;double&gt;?, CancellationToken) { #m-fetchasync-system-net-http-httpclient-nfty-core-publis-10a76c }

```csharp
public static Task<string> FetchAsync(HttpClient http, CommunityEntry entry, string cacheDir, IProgress<double>? progress, CancellationToken ct);
```

Downloads `entry`'s Set into `cacheDir`, verified.

**Parameters**

- `http` (`HttpClient`) - A client with no credentials on it.
- `entry` (`CommunityEntry`) - The listed entry; its Set file's size and hash are what the bytes must match.
- `cacheDir` (`string`) - The folder holding downloaded Sets; created when missing.
- `progress` (`IProgress<double>?`) - Receives the fraction of the listed size received, 0 to 1.
- `ct` (`CancellationToken`) - Stops the download.

**Returns.** The path `<cacheDir>/<sha256>.set`; a cached copy that still hashes right is returned without a request.

**Exceptions**

- [`CommunityException`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.CommunityException.md) - The download failed or did not match the listing; the message is a [`ShareRules`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.ShareRules.md) sentence.
- `OperationCanceledException` - `ct` was canceled.
